findings.resolution: Plan rewritten to narrow fix scope to codex-exec.mjs:63 + copilot-exec.mjs:243 only. Other 8 sites explicitly marked SKIP-WITH-REASON in the Bug Surface Audit table.
findings.summary: Option A (`shell: true` universally) breaks argv quoting on POSIX for ralph.mjs and review-loop.mjs sites that pass `## section` headers and commit messages with spaces.
findings.rationale: ralph.mjs:967 passes literal strings like `"## prd.json"`, `"## progress tail (last 300 lines)"`, `"## notepad"` as positional `--section HEADER PATH` args to bash. review-loop.mjs:588 and :827 do the same. With `shell: true`, Node joins argv with spaces and passes a single string to `/bin/sh -c`; the shell would treat `##` as a comment marker, dropping the rest of the line. git.mjs:8 has the same risk with multi-word commit messages passed to git from ralph.mjs:706. Codex and Copilot reviewers flagged this independently.
findings.remediation: Narrow the fix to only the spawn sites that target Windows .cmd shims: `src/codex-exec.mjs:63` and `src/copilot-exec.mjs:243`. Leave bash/git spawns alone — `.exe` binaries are resolved by Windows CreateProcess without shell, and the section-header argv would be corrupted under shell quoting.

findings.rationale: All three reviewers (Claude, Codex, Copilot) flagged this. `path-utils.mjs` has its own `runGit` helper at line 102-117 using `execFileSync("git", args, ...)`. Verified by reading origin/main:plugins/ralph/src/path-utils.mjs.
findings.remediation: Include path-utils.mjs:112 in the audit table. Under the revised narrow-fix approach (F-001), it remains SKIP-WITH-REASON (target is git.exe, works without shell).

findings.resolution: review-loop.mjs spawn sites are no longer patched (per F-001 narrow scope), so the missing DI seam is moot. Flagged as separate cleanup PR in Out of Scope.
findings.summary: Proposed test seam for `spawnEngineWithStreaming` (review-loop.mjs:889) is not implementable — function is private and captures module-level `spawn`.
findings.rationale: Codex and Copilot both noted: `spawnEngineWithStreaming` does not accept an injectable spawn argument. Exporting it is insufficient; the function references the module-imported `spawn` directly. A test seam would require either a dependency-injection refactor or test-through-`main(...)` integration coverage.
findings.remediation: Under the revised narrow-fix approach (F-001), review-loop.mjs is NOT patched, so this test work is dropped from scope. If a future fix patches review-loop, plan must include the DI refactor as a prerequisite story.

Under the revised narrow-fix approach this is less critical (we're only patching codex-exec/copilot-exec, which don't pass section headers), but a smoke test for paths-with-spaces in the prompt path argv would still surface the quoting risk.
